title: For young & old
text: Two absolute highlights. Exciting. Funny. Experience culture up close (& air-conditioned). The immersive experience was my highlight. The children had a great time. But the parents will also be amazed.
author: Nadine_D

title: Fun for the whole family
text:
This “museum” is amazing. It tells the story of Barcelona in a new and exciting way.
You need to use all your senses when experiencing Barcelona.
You have to dance, listen, see, experiencing VR and more.
Several of the rooms were interactive and fun for the whole family.
Will recommend.

author: t_nis2014

title: Good for all ages
text: The White Rabbit immersive experience was great - we expected an art based immersive like are popular now and found that it was actually focused on Barcelona’s history and culture - which was really cool. The candy museum stated with a small sample of gummies, and while I’m sure small kids have fun, they could do a better job making interactive exhibits. It’s mostly a bunch of photo opps, a ball pit, a slide and a jumpy room. A lot of extra space they could do more with. That said it was nice to see my teens have fun like little kids again.
